snippet.title: Bloodbath | Steam Launch Teaser
snippet.description:
Would you be able to command an android on a paranormal mission through a computer?

Bloodbath is a game where you write the actions an android must perform to find a paranormal object in an abandoned mansion full of secrets.

Wishlist now on Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/4623520/Bloodbath/
